name: Party Role 2 Code
definition: Specifies the role of the party in the transaction.

DIST.name: Distributor
DIST.definition: Party that act as an wholesaler of funds.

LGRD.name: Legal Guardian
LGRD.definition: Party that has been appointed by a legal authority to act on behalf of a person judged to be incapacitated.

DECM.name: Decision Maker
DECM.definition: Party that is authorised to take investment decisions on behalf of the shareholder.
